_comment: LabVIEW's own library functions that Call Library Function Nodes call by the library name LabVIEW (NI: "LabVIEW Manager Functions"), and the Python each is generated as. `parameters` are NI's names in call order (the return value excluded). `statements` are the Python source lines written in place of the call: {name} is the Python expression of the input of parameter `name`, and {out0} (the MgErr return value), {out1}, {out2} ... are the variables the output sides of the return value and of each parameter row are bound to; they are the only names a statement may assign for the node's results. `imports` and `declarations` (keys of the top-level `declarations`, each `{name}` of which is substituted by the module-level name it is defined under) are added to the module. A failure is the Python exception of the call.

FInfoRec.name: _FInfoRec
source: _fields_ = [('type', ctypes.c_int32), ('creator', ctypes.c_int32), ('permissions', ctypes.c_int32), ('size', ctypes.c_int32), ('rf_size', ctypes.c_int32), ('cdate', ctypes.c_uint32), ('mdate', ctypes.c_uint32), ('folder', ctypes.c_int32), ('is_invisible', ctypes.c_int32), ('location_v', ctypes.c_int16), ('location_h', ctypes.c_int16), ('owner', ctypes.c_ubyte * 256), ('group', ctypes.c_ubyte * 256)]

statements: {out2} = list(bytes({FInfoRec}(permissions=stat.S_IMODE(_status.st_mode), size=len(os.listdir({path})) if _folder else min(_status.st_size, 2147483647), cdate=int(_created) + 2082844800, mdate=int(_status.st_mtime) + 2082844800, folder=int(_folder), owner=(ctypes.c_ubyte * 256)(len(_owner), *_owner), group=(ctypes.c_ubyte * 256)(len(_group), *_group))))
